combos.about: Super Polymerization is a Quick-Play Spell. You discard 1 card and Fusion Summon using monsters from EITHER field, and nobody can respond to it. Going second, you use it to turn two of your opponent's best monsters, or one of theirs and one of yours, into one Fusion Monster on your side. Pick the Fusion from what the two monsters have in common. Your own pairs: Elzette + Silvy (both LIGHT Spellcasters) for Garura, and Elzette + Diabellze (LIGHT, different Types) for Mudragon.

steps.t: Activate Super Polymerization by discarding 1 card. Neither player can respond to it.
Both monsters share a Type and an Attribute but have different names → Garura, Wings of Resonant Life. If Garura later goes to the GY, you draw 1.
Same Attribute but different Types → Mudragon of the Swamp. Your opponent can't target it, or your monsters of its Attribute, with effects.
Both are DARK monsters on the field (not Tokens) → Starving Venom Fusion Dragon.
Same Type but different Attributes → Favorite HERO Flame Wingman.
Their two monsters leave the field as Fusion Material, so destruction protection doesn't save them. Then attack.

end.t: Their two key monsters are gone and you have a Fusion Monster to attack with. You can also Set Super Polymerization and use it on your opponent's turn.

rules: You choose the Fusion Monster. Check the Type and Attribute shown on each card before you activate it.
Fusions that must be Summoned another way ("cannot be Fusion Summoned" or contact Fusions) are not legal choices.
Witch of the White Forest's DARK lock blocks Garura and Starving Venom. Use Super Polymerization before you activate Witch.

Once Sarcophagus is on the field, Horus monsters in your GY can Special Summon themselves. Sarcophagus also lets you send Hapi from your Deck to the GY, so both Level 8s come straight back out. They are hard to remove: effects that destroy without targeting can't touch them.

Activate King's Sarcophagus (a Continuous Spell).
King's Sarcophagus: send the card you drew from your hand to the GY. Then send Hapi from your Deck to the GY.
You control King's Sarcophagus, so Special Summon Imsety from your GY.
Special Summon Hapi from your GY the same way.

combos.h: Line A — Dormouse into Red Ransom
combos.about: Maliss monsters come back when they are banished: pay 300 LP and they Special Summon themselves. So you banish your own cards on purpose. Dormouse banishes White Rabbit from the Deck, White Rabbit returns and Sets a Maliss Trap, and Haggard Lizardose recycles Dormouse into the Link-3 Red Ransom. Red Ransom finds the Field Spell, and the Field Spell banishes one more Maliss to bring it out too.

steps.t: Normal Summon Dormouse. Its Main Phase effect banishes White Rabbit from your Deck, and your Maliss monsters gain 600 ATK this turn.
White Rabbit was banished: pay 300 LP to Special Summon it. From now on you can only Special Summon Link Monsters from the Extra Deck this turn.
White Rabbit was Summoned: Set Maliss <C> MTP-07 from your Deck.
Link Summon Haggard Lizardose (2 monsters with different names) using Dormouse + White Rabbit.
Lizardose: banish Dormouse (900 ATK) from your GY and target Lizardose. Dormouse was banished, so pay 300 LP to Special Summon it.
Link Summon Maliss <Q> Red Ransom (2+ monsters including a Maliss) using Lizardose + Dormouse.
Red Ransom was Special Summoned: add Maliss in Underground (a Maliss Spell) from your Deck.
Activate Maliss in Underground: banish Chessy Cat from your Deck. Chessy Cat was banished, so pay 300 LP to Special Summon it.

end.t: Red Ransom + Chessy Cat + Maliss in Underground + a Set MTP-07. While Red Ransom points to a monster, the original ATK and DEF of your opponent's Effect Monsters are switched. While you control a Maliss Link, Underground lets them attack only your Maliss Links. On their turn, MTP-07 adds a Maliss monster and banishes 1 card on the field.

rules: Every banish-and-return costs 300 LP and locks you to Link Monsters from the Extra Deck for the turn.
Each Maliss card's effects are once per turn by name.
Don't resolve Kashtiratheosis first: it locks you to Xyz Monsters, which shuts off every Maliss Link.

Kashtiratheosis turns it into a second body by pulling Unicorn from the Deck. Fenrir banishes 1 of your opponent's face-up cards face-down when it attacks, and Unicorn banishes a card from their Extra Deck when they use a monster effect.

Fenrir's Main Phase effect: add your second Kashtira Fenrir from the Deck for next turn.
Fenrir declares an attack: banish 1 face-up card your opponent controls, face-down.
If your opponent activates a monster effect, Unicorn looks at their Extra Deck and banishes 1 monster face-down.

end.t: Fenrir + Unicorn. Fenrir has already removed 1 of their cards for good, and you hold a second Fenrir.

rules: Fenrir and Unicorn can't Special Summon themselves once you control a monster. Fenrir's search can't fetch Unicorn into a useful spot, so get Unicorn with Kashtiratheosis.

combos.about: Runick is a control deck. Your Quick-Play Spells either disrupt your opponent or Summon a Runick Fusion from the Extra Deck, and each one banishes cards from the top of their Deck. Turn one sets up the engine: Inspector Boarder limits monster effects, Runick Fountain lets you cast Runick Quick-Plays from your hand on their turn, and Munin finds Runick Allure, which banishes their top card every time any Quick-Play is activated.

steps.t: Normal Summon Inspector Boarder while your field is empty (it can't be Summoned if you control a monster).
Activate Terraforming: add Runick Fountain from your Deck.
Activate Runick Fountain (Field Spell).
Activate Runick Tip, Summon mode: Special Summon Munin the Runick Wings to the Extra Monster Zone. You will skip your next Battle Phase.
Munin was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: discard your second Inspector Boarder and add Runick Allure. Munin is a Fusion, so it opens 1 monster-effect slot under Inspector Boarder.
Activate Runick Allure (Continuous Spell). Keep Runick Flashing Fire in your hand for your opponent's turn.

end.t: Inspector Boarder + Munin + Fountain + Allure, with Flashing Fire in hand. Neither player can activate more monster effects per turn than there are monster card types (Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Link…) on the field. If your opponent targets a Runick card or a Set card you control, Munin can banish itself to negate it. On their turn, Flashing Fire from your hand destroys a Special Summoned monster. Allure then banishes their top card, and Fountain recycles your used Quick-Plays.

rules: Every Runick Quick-Play makes you skip your next Battle Phase, whichever mode you use.
Fountain's recycle-and-draw is once per turn and only targets Runick Quick-Plays already in your GY.
Inspector Boarder limits you too: with only Munin's type on the field, each player gets 1 monster effect per turn.

facts.t: **Scareclaw self-Summons go only to a Main Monster Zone adjacent to a Scareclaw you control or in its column.** A Scareclaw Link in an Extra Monster Zone opens the zone directly below it. Without a Scareclaw on board, Acro/Belone/Astra/Reichheart cannot use their own Summon procedure.
**Scareclaw Light-Heart** can only use a monster in your **Main Monster Zone** as material, and its Reichphobia search triggers only if it is Link Summoned **into the Extra Monster Zone**.

**Visas Starfrost** needs a monster you control with a **different Type AND different Attribute** from it (it is LIGHT / Warrior). Scareclaw Reichheart (DARK **Warrior**) and Visas Samsara (**LIGHT** Fairy) are not legal targets; Acro/Belone/Astra (EARTH Beast), the Kashtiras (EARTH/WIND Psychic) and Ash Blossom (FIRE Zombie) are.

**Vicious Astraloud** is a contact Fusion (banish Visas Starfrost + a 1500 ATK / 2100 DEF monster from field/GY). It is **not** a Super Polymerization target. Reichheart and Visas Samsara both have exactly 1500 / 2100.

**Scareclaw Tri-Heart turns all face-up monsters to Defense Position** and its own revive/search clause locks you to Scareclaw Special Summons for the rest of the turn — finish Extra Deck plays first.

facts.t: **King's Sarcophagus is a Continuous Spell** with exactly three effects: non-targeting destruction protection for Horus monsters; send 1 card from hand to GY → send 1 Horus monster from Deck to GY (up to four times per turn); once-per-turn battle removal. It has **no** "Special Summon a Horus from Deck" or "draw" clause.
**Hapi has two effects:** GY self-Summon while you control King's Sarcophagus, and an on-opponent-removal trigger that adds or shuffles 2 banished/GY cards.

**Earthbound Prisoner Stone Sweeper needs a card in a Field Zone** to Summon itself — this list runs **no Field Spells**, so its self-Summon is live only if the opponent has one. Its discard-search works regardless.

**Most Resonator effects lock you to DARK (Dragon) Synchro Extra Deck Summons** for the turn. Super Polymerization targets (Garura, Mudragon, Flame Wingman), TY-PHON, S:P Little Knight and Chengying (WATER) are blocked on those turns.
**Scarred Dragon Archfiend's name becomes "Red Dragon Archfiend"** on the field and in the GY; **The Crimson King's does not** (it only searches an RDA-mentioning card and can Summon an RDA).

**Red Rising Dragon's GY effect needs two Level 1 "Resonator" monsters in your GY** — no Resonator in this list is Level 1 in the GY (Darkness Resonator's Level change only applies on the field). Treat that clause as dead text.

Horus engine adds a removal-punishing second plan and feeds the Resonator GY effects.
Strong hand-trap package for going second.
weak: Heavy self-locks (DARK / DARK Dragon Synchro) restrict the generic Extra Deck toolbox.
Stone Sweeper's Summon condition depends on an opponent Field Spell.
Red Rising Dragon's GY effect is dead in this list.
Red Dragon Archfiend's End Phase self-destruction punishes wide boards that didn't attack.

combos.h: Line A — Soul Resonator into Crimson King and Scarred
combos.about: Resonators are Fiend Tuners that build Red Dragon Archfiend Synchros. Soul Resonator finds Bone Archfiend, and Bone Archfiend sends Vision Resonator from your Deck to the GY, which searches Crimson Gaia. Soul + Bone make The Crimson King. Crimson King searches Power Vice Dragon, and Power Vice finds Darkness Resonator for a second Level 8, Scarred Dragon Archfiend. Earthbound Immortal Red Nova is the extra threat for your opponent's turn.

steps.t: Normal Summon Soul Resonator: add Bone Archfiend. You can only Special Summon DARK Synchros from the Extra Deck this turn.
Bone Archfiend: send Super Polymerization from your hand to the GY and Special Summon Bone Archfiend. Lock: DARK Dragon Synchros only.
Bone Archfiend: send Vision Resonator (Fiend Tuner) from your Deck to the GY. Bone becomes Level 5.
Vision Resonator was sent to the GY: add Crimson Gaia (it mentions Red Dragon Archfiend).
Synchro Summon The Crimson King (Level 8) using Soul Resonator (3, Tuner) + Bone Archfiend (5, DARK).
The Crimson King was Synchro Summoned: add Power Vice Dragon (it mentions Red Dragon Archfiend).
All your monsters are DARK Synchros: Special Summon Power Vice Dragon. It adds Darkness Resonator.
Reveal Red Dragon Archfiend in your Extra Deck to Special Summon Darkness Resonator. Lock: Synchros only.
Synchro Summon Scarred Dragon Archfiend (Level 8) using Darkness Resonator (3, Tuner) + Power Vice Dragon (5, DARK).
Activate Crimson Gaia. Its Main Phase effect adds Earthbound Immortal Red Nova from your Deck.

end.t: The Crimson King + Scarred Dragon Archfiend + Crimson Gaia, with Earthbound Immortal Red Nova in hand. When they activate a monster effect, Crimson King banishes itself to Summon Red Dragon Archfiend at double ATK. In either Main Phase, Red Nova sends Scarred (named Red Dragon Archfiend) to Summon Red Nova Dragon.

rules: Use Scarred, not Red Dragon Archfiend, as the second Level 8. Red Dragon Archfiend destroys your other monsters that didn't attack in your End Phase.
Scarred also bringing out Red Dragon Archfiend after Red Nova sends it is a timing ruling in your guide. Confirm it with a judge.
Almost every Resonator locks you to DARK (Dragon) Synchros for the turn, so Super Polymerization belongs on another turn.

combos.about: Two copies of Earthbound Immortal Red Nova make a Level 12 boss with no Normal Summon. In either player's Main Phase, banish one Red Nova from your hand and send the other to the GY. Then Summon Red Nova Dragon from the Extra Deck, which counts as a Synchro Summon. Red Nova Dragon can't be destroyed by your opponent's effects and gets stronger for every Tuner in your GY.

steps.t: Main Phase (yours or theirs), Quick Effect: banish Earthbound Immortal Red Nova #1 from your hand.
Its effect sends Red Nova #2 (an Earthbound Immortal) from your hand to the GY.
Then Special Summon Red Nova Dragon from your Extra Deck. It counts as a Synchro Summon.
Red Nova Dragon gains 500 ATK for each Tuner in your GY and can't be destroyed by your opponent's effects.
Next turn, Red Nova #2 can use the same effect from the GY by sending a Red Dragon Archfiend (or Scarred) you control.

end.t: Red Nova Dragon (3500+). When an opponent's monster attacks, it banishes itself to negate the attack, then returns in the End Phase.

rules: Only 1 Earthbound Immortal can be on the field at a time.
Earthbound Immortal Red Nova's effect is once per turn by name.

combos.about: The Horus cards are a second engine whose costs feed the Resonators. Imsety sends itself plus another card from your hand. Pick Vision Resonator, which then searches Crimson Gaia. Imsety finds King's Sarcophagus, Sarcophagus sends Hapi from your Deck to the GY, and both Horus Level 8s Summon themselves from the GY. This works even when your Resonator starter gets stopped.

steps.t: Imsety: send it + Vision Resonator from your hand to the GY. Add King's Sarcophagus, then draw 1.
Vision Resonator was sent to the GY: add Crimson Gaia.
Activate King's Sarcophagus. Send Bone Archfiend from your hand to the GY to send Hapi from your Deck to the GY.
You control King's Sarcophagus: Special Summon Imsety and then Hapi from your GY.
Activate Crimson Gaia. Bone Archfiend can later Summon itself from your GY by sending 1 card.

end.t: Imsety + Hapi + King's Sarcophagus + Crimson Gaia, with Bone Archfiend ready in the GY.

rules: King's Sarcophagus's send works up to 4 times per turn. Each discard can be a Resonator piece you want in the GY.
Imsety and Hapi each Summon themselves from the GY only once per turn.

combos.about: Super Polymerization is a Quick-Play Spell. You discard 1 card and Fusion Summon using monsters from EITHER field, and nobody can respond to it. Going second, you use it to turn two of your opponent's best monsters, or one of theirs and one of yours, into one Fusion Monster on your side. Pick the Fusion from what the two monsters have in common. Your own pairs: Bone Archfiend + Stone Sweeper (DARK Fiends) for Garura, and Soul Resonator (FIRE Fiend) + Bone Archfiend (DARK Fiend) for Flame Wingman.

steps.t: Activate Super Polymerization by discarding 1 card. Neither player can respond to it.
Both monsters share a Type and an Attribute but have different names → Garura, Wings of Resonant Life. If Garura later goes to the GY, you draw 1.
Same Attribute but different Types → Mudragon of the Swamp. Your opponent can't target it, or your monsters of its Attribute, with effects.
Same Type but different Attributes → Favorite HERO Flame Wingman.
Their two monsters leave the field as Fusion Material, so destruction protection doesn't save them. Then attack.

end.t: Their two key monsters are gone and you have a Fusion Monster to attack with. You can also Set Super Polymerization and use it on your opponent's turn.

rules: You choose the Fusion Monster. Check the Type and Attribute shown on each card before you activate it.
Fusions that must be Summoned another way ("cannot be Fusion Summoned" or contact Fusions) are not legal choices.
Almost every Resonator effect locks you to DARK Synchros. Use Super Polymerization on a turn without those locks, or on your opponent's turn.

facts.t: **Maiden of White places True Light face-up** in the Spell & Trap Zone (not Set). True Light's effects are usable once it is face-up — and if that face-up True Light is sent to the GY, **all your monsters are destroyed**.

**Mausoleum of White does not mention "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"** — it is not a target for Wishes for Eyes of Blue, Bingo Machine, Go!!! or True Light's Set effect. Its only searcher here is Spirit with Eyes of Blue.

**Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon is Level 8** (not 10). It can be Special Summoned by Tributing a BEWD equipped with a Fusion Monster — Wishes for Eyes of Blue's GY effect equips **Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon** for exactly this (confirmed line).

**Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon** = 1 Tuner Synchro + 2+ non-Tuner Synchros, **must be Synchro Summoned** — it arrives only through Crimson Dragon's replacement effect (treated as a Synchro Summon). Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon's Tribute effect **cannot** Summon it.
**Crimson Dragon's on-Summon search is live:** Synchro Rumble mentions "Crimson Dragon".
**Sage with Eyes of Blue is 0 ATK / 1500 DEF**; **Spirit with Eyes of Blue is ATK 300**, Link Arrow Bottom-Left.

str: Layered disruption board (Spirit GY negate → BEUSD omni-negate → Sifr protection + negate).
Many search paths to BEWD and Tuners.
Primite Drillbeam ×3 recurring negate-banish.
Tyrant Dragon line needs no Fusion Spell.

Only 2 BEWD; heavy reliance on recovering them.
Spirit with Eyes of Blue / Lordly Lode / Spirit Dragon self-restrictions.

combos.about: Sage with Eyes of Blue finds Maiden of White. Sage becomes Spirit with Eyes of Blue, which finds Mausoleum of White, and Mausoleum gives you a second Normal Summon for Maiden. Mausoleum also puts Blue-Eyes White Dragon in the GY. Maiden places True Light, True Light revives Blue-Eyes, and Maiden comes back. Maiden + Blue-Eyes make Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon, which stops GY effects and can become another Synchro on either player's turn.

steps.t: Normal Summon Sage: add Maiden of White (a Level 1 LIGHT Tuner) from your Deck.
Link Summon Spirit with Eyes of Blue using Sage. While you control it, you can only Special Summon Dragons.
Spirit was Link Summoned: add Mausoleum of White. Activate it.
Mausoleum gives an extra Normal Summon for a Level 1 LIGHT Tuner: Normal Summon Maiden of White.
Mausoleum: target Spirit and send Blue-Eyes White Dragon from your Deck to the GY.
Maiden: send itself from the field to the GY and place True Light face-up from your Deck.
True Light: Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon from your GY.
You Special Summoned Blue-Eyes White Dragon, so Maiden of White Special Summons itself from the GY.
Synchro Summon Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon (Level 9) using Maiden (1, Tuner) + Blue-Eyes White Dragon (8).
Tribute Spirit with Eyes of Blue: Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon from your GY.

end.t: Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon + Blue-Eyes White Dragon + True Light. Spirit Dragon negates a GY effect once per turn, and neither player can Special Summon 2+ monsters at once. On either player's turn, Spirit Dragon can Tribute itself to Summon Lightstorm Dragon (destroys Spells/Traps) or Crimson Dragon. True Light stops your opponent targeting Blue-Eyes White Dragon.

rules: Sage only searches when Normal Summoned.
If face-up True Light is sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY, all your monsters are destroyed.
Spirit with Eyes of Blue only lets you Special Summon Dragons, which blocks S:P Little Knight and TY-PHON while it's on the field.

combos.about: Primite Dragon Ether Beryl Sets Primite Lordly Lode, which searches Primite support and can Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon from your Deck. The catch: after Lode's Summon effect, nobody's Special Summoned monsters can activate effects that turn, and that includes yours. Use Lode's Summon as your last play, and keep a Normal Monster on the field so Primite Drillbeam can be used for free.

steps.t: Normal Summon Ether Beryl: Set Primite Lordly Lode from your Deck.
Activate Lordly Lode: add Primite Drillbeam from your Deck.
Last play of the turn: Lode declares Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Summons it from your Deck in Defense Position. Your Special Summoned monsters can't activate effects for the rest of the turn.
Set Primite Drillbeam. While you control a Normal Monster, you can activate it without revealing a card.

end.t: Ether Beryl + Blue-Eyes White Dragon + Lordly Lode + a Set Drillbeam. On your opponent's turn, Drillbeam negates and banishes 1 face-up card. Lode gives your Normal and Primite monsters 300 ATK per differently-named Normal Monster in your GY.

rules: Lode's lock means Neo Kaiser Sea Horse, Spirit Dragon and other Special Summoned monsters can't use effects that turn. Do those plays before Lode's Summon.
Drillbeam re-Sets itself from your GY in your Main Phase while you control a Primite monster.

combos.about: Wishes for Eyes of Blue finds a Tuner and Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons. Roar puts Blue-Eyes White Dragon on the field. Wishes then works again from the GY: it equips Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon from your Extra Deck to that Blue-Eyes. A Blue-Eyes equipped with a Fusion can be Tributed to Summon Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon, which is unaffected by Traps and attacks every monster your opponent controls.

steps.t: Activate Wishes for Eyes of Blue by discarding 1 card. Add Sage with Eyes of Blue (Level 1 LIGHT Tuner) and Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons from your Deck.
Roar: Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon from your Deck in Defense Position. You can only Special Summon Dragons from the Extra Deck this turn.
Banish Wishes from your GY: equip Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon from your Extra Deck to Blue-Eyes White Dragon (+400 ATK).
Tribute that Blue-Eyes White Dragon (equipped with a Fusion Monster) to Special Summon Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon from your Extra Deck.
Normal Summon Sage: add Maiden of White for later.
Battle: Tyrant Dragon (3400) attacks every monster your opponent controls once each. After a battle, it Sets a Trap from your GY.

end.t: Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon clears their monsters, and Traps can't touch it.

rules: Wishes can only add a Spell/Trap that names Blue-Eyes White Dragon. Mausoleum and Primite cards don't qualify.
Summoning Tyrant by Tributing an equipped Blue-Eyes is a confirmed line.
Roar's lock is Dragons only from the Extra Deck, and Tyrant is a Dragon.

Longyuan's Token + Longyuan makes Supreme Sovereign Chengying. While a Token is on the field you can only Special Summon Synchro Monsters from the Extra Deck.

steps.t: Normal Summon Mo Ye. Reveal Longyuan (a Swordsoul card) from your hand to Special Summon a Swordsoul Token.
Synchro Summon Swordsoul Grandmaster - Chixiao (Level 8) using the Token (4, Tuner) + Mo Ye (4, Wyrm). Mo Ye, as Synchro Material, draws you 1 card.
Chixiao was Synchro Summoned: add Swordsoul of Taia from your Deck.
Longyuan: discard Taia (another Swordsoul card) to Special Summon Longyuan and a second Swordsoul Token.
Synchro Summon Swordsoul Supreme Sovereign - Chengying (Level 10) using the Token (4) + Longyuan (6). Longyuan, as material, deals 1200 damage.

end.t: Chixiao + Chengying. If Chengying would be destroyed by an effect, you banish a card from your GY instead. Whenever a card is banished, it banishes 1 card from your opponent's field and 1 from their GY.

rules: You can only use 1 Chixiao effect per turn. If it searches, it can't negate until your next turn. Skip the search when you need the negate on their turn.
If Ash Blossom stops Chixiao's search, Longyuan still works: discard any other Swordsoul card or Wyrm.

Suruya used as material for a Wyrm Synchro brings out Monk of the Tenyi.

Monk is a face-up non-Effect Monster, so in your next Main Phase you can banish Vishuda from the GY to return 1 of their cards to the hand.

rules: Use the Token before you need Monk. While a Token is on the field you can only Special Summon Synchros, and Monk is a Link.
Monk Summoned by Suruya can't be used as Link Material.

**No "Sky Striker Ace" Main Deck monster is run** (no Raye/Roze). The Ace Links come from Sky Striker Mecha - Hornet Drones' **Sky Striker Ace Token** (DARK Warrior Level 1, non-Effect) and Effect Monsters. Sky Striker Ace = Zero's Tribute effect (Summon Raye + Roze) is **dead text** here.

combos.h: Line B — Tenpai Battle Phase OTK
combos.about: The Tenpai Dragons Synchro Summon in the middle of your Battle Phase as Quick Effects. Paidra searches the Field Spell, the Field Spell finds Chundra, and Chundra pulls Fadra out of your Deck mid-battle. You Synchro into Sangenpai Bident Dragion, which revives Paidra. Then you Synchro into Sangenpai Transcendent Dragion, which stops your opponent activating anything for the rest of the Battle Phase.

Activate Sangen Summoning. Its Main Phase effect adds Tenpai Dragon Chundra, then you discard 1 card (Effect Veiler).
You control a FIRE Dragon: Special Summon Chundra from your hand.
Battle Phase: Paidra attacks. At the start of the Damage Step, Chundra Special Summons Tenpai Dragon Fadra from your Deck.
After that battle, Chundra (Quick Effect): Synchro Summon Sangenpai Bident Dragion (Level 7) using Chundra (4, Dragon Tuner) + Paidra (3).
Bident Dragion was Synchro Summoned: Special Summon Paidra from your GY. Only Dragons can be Special Summoned for the rest of the turn.
Fadra (Quick Effect): Synchro Summon Sangenpai Transcendent Dragion (Level 10) using Bident Dragion (7, Dragon Tuner) + Fadra (3).
Transcendent Dragion was Synchro Summoned: change all monsters to Attack Position. Your opponent can't activate cards or effects for the rest of the Battle Phase.
Attack with Transcendent Dragion (3000) and the revived Paidra. That makes 3 attacks this turn, so Bident Dragion can Summon itself from your GY (once per Duel) and destroy 1 Spell/Trap.

end.t: A Battle Phase your opponent can't respond to, with three or more attacks on monsters forced into Attack Position.

rules: Sangen Summoning's search makes you discard a card, so keep a spare card in hand.
Paidra's search and Fadra's revive are each once per turn, so the revived Paidra doesn't search again.

Link Summon Sky Striker Ace - Camellia using the stolen monster + Kagari, so their monster is gone for good.

end.t: Camellia on your field and their best monster gone. Keep the other Widow Anchor in hand for their next big monster.

Set Solemn Judgment to stop their biggest Summon or Spell/Trap.

end.t: Inspector Boarder + Necrovalley + Set Macro Cosmos and Solemn Judgment. Each player can activate only as many monster effects per turn as there are monster card types on the field. With Macro Cosmos up, anything sent to the GY is banished instead.

rules: Your floodgates hit you too. Inspector Boarder also limits your hand traps, Albaz and Gizmek Orochi.
Don't Set Infinite Impermanence in a column with your face-up Continuous Spells. Its column lock negates them.

combos.about: Fallen of Albaz fuses itself with one of your opponent's monsters when it is Normal Summoned. Pick the Fusion from what their monster is. Mirrorjade then banishes another monster, and Decisive Battle of Golgonda keeps your Fusion safe: send an Albaz Fusion from your Extra Deck instead of letting your card be destroyed.

steps.t: Activate Decisive Battle of Golgonda (Continuous Spell).

Normal Summon Fallen of Albaz. Discard Effect Veiler to fuse Albaz with their monster: Mirrorjade (an Extra Deck monster), Brigrand (Level 8+), Titaniklad (2500+ ATK) or Predaplant Dragostapelia (a Fusion).
Mirrorjade (Quick Effect): send Titaniklad from your Extra Deck to the GY to banish 1 monster on the field.
If your Mirrorjade would be destroyed, Golgonda sends Brigrand from your Extra Deck to the GY instead.

end.t: Mirrorjade with Golgonda protection, and two of their monsters removed.

rules: You run only 1 Albaz, so Titaniklad and Brigrand's End Phase Albaz search has nothing to find once Albaz is used.
